name: Ingenium Intuito Group Corp. (Clima-Cool)
summary: Fixing the business-identity problems first (correct phone, address, and schema so Google understands who you are and where), then consolidating duplicate pages and building deeper service content to close the gap on competitors.

tasks.title: Confirm brand, phone & address (client sign-off)
tasks.detail: Locked in the three decisions that were blocking every other fix: primary brand (Ingenium Intuito Group Corp.), primary phone (437) 431-6089, and primary address (10 Eva Rd, Etobicoke).

tasks.title: Fix the phone number on Google Business Profile
tasks.detail: The 'Call' button on Google was pointing to the wrong number — a live leak of booked jobs. Updated to the correct (437) 431-6089.

tasks.title: Fix the website footer address
tasks.detail: Corrected the footer sitewide to the confirmed address (10 Eva Rd, Etobicoke, ON M9C 0B3) so it matches Google and every listing.

tasks.title: Add LocalBusiness schema to the homepage
tasks.detail: Added machine-readable business identity (name, phone, address, hours) to the homepage so Google clearly understands who and where you are. Confirmed live via view-source.

tasks.title: Remove the fake testimonial
tasks.detail: Removed the placeholder 'SparklePro' testimonial from the AC repair page to protect trust and credibility, and replaced it with a genuine HVAC review.

tasks.title: Add meta description — commercial water heater page
tasks.detail: Wrote a meta description for the commercial water heater page so it shows a proper summary in search results.

tasks.title: Review title tags & meta descriptions on key pages
tasks.detail: Reviewed and updated titles/meta descriptions across 5 key service pages (AC repair, duct cleaning, gas line repair, heat pump, emergency furnace repair) where they were missing.

tasks.title: Fix the Torontovka listing address
tasks.detail: Correct the address on the Torontovka directory listing to match the canonical address everywhere else.

tasks.title: Confirm GBP primary category → HVAC contractor
tasks.detail: Change the Google category from 'Furnace repair service' to 'HVAC contractor' to match the full range of services.

tasks.title: Fix 4 URL typos with 301 redirects (redo correctly)
tasks.detail: The first attempt created new correctly-spelled pages alongside the old typo URLs with no redirect — adding duplicates instead of fixing them. Redo by renaming the original pages' slugs in Wix so the 301 redirect fires automatically.

tasks.title: Fix multiple H1 headings on AC repair page
tasks.detail: The Etobicoke AC repair page has several H1 headings — demote the extras to H2/H3 so there's one clear H1 per page.

tasks.title: Consolidate duplicate page clusters
tasks.detail: Merge the duplicated AC repair and heat pump pages into one strong page each — this also closes the biggest gap against the top competitor.

tasks.title: Remove the UK ghost sitemap
tasks.detail: Delete a stray UK sitemap that duplicates the Canadian site and confuses search engines.

tasks.title: GBP post — duct cleaning in Etobicoke
tasks.detail: Created a Google Business Profile post promoting duct cleaning in Etobicoke, following the geo-anchored template with the standard link cluster.

tasks.title: Rewrite Etobicoke AC repair as one deep page
tasks.detail: Replace the three thin AC repair pages with a single comprehensive 2,500+ word page with FAQ and troubleshooting content.

tasks.title: Add review schema (5.0★ / 32 reviews)
tasks.detail: Surface your real Google rating in structured data so it can show in search results — a clear edge over competitors.

tasks.title: Build brand-specific repair pages
tasks.detail: Create dedicated pages for Mitsubishi, Rinnai, Carrier, and Omega repair to capture '[brand] repair GTA' searches.

tasks.title: Turn real job stories into blog posts
tasks.detail: Repurpose real Instagram case studies (real technician, real jobs) into specific, technical blog posts that earn AI and search citations.

updates.note: Big week of foundational fixes shipped. Your business identity is now clean and consistent: correct phone and address everywhere, business schema live on the homepage, the fake testimonial removed, and titles/meta descriptions reviewed across your key service pages. Next: cleaning up duplicate pages and misspelled URLs, then deeper service-page content.

Fixed the website footer address sitewide (10 Eva Rd, Etobicoke), added LocalBusiness schema to the homepage so Google understands who and where you are, and removed the placeholder testimonial from the AC repair page.

Confirmed the three decisions that were blocking everything else — primary brand, phone, and address — then fixed the wrong phone number on Google Business Profile, which had been sending 'Call' taps to the wrong number and costing booked jobs.
